title: Owner gate follow-ups from RF-100: push race, cancelled CI runs, honest gate failures
acceptance: Push race: void-approval never removes an owner-approved label added after the current head was pushed (repository activity API push time vs the label's timeline time), and keeps the label whenever either time is unknown; a label added before the push, with no approval on the head, is still dropped.

A label event can no longer leave a CI run 'cancelled': ci.yml has no gate job and writes no commit status; owner-gate.yml writes `owner-gate` on every PR event (opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled) from one job in the per-PR concurrency group, so writes stay serialized and the last write reads the live state. pr-gates.sh self-check enforces both.
When record-approval fails, `owner-gate` reads 'Recording owner approval failed; re-run the job or re-add the label' (or the refusal reason), not 'need owner-approved'.

gate-status classifies the result from scripts/owner-gate.mjs's machine-readable verdict (OWNER_GATE_RESULT JSON: clean, approved, unapproved), never its log text; a missing verdict is an error that fails closed. owner-gate.test.mjs covers the verdict file.

record-approval refuses to bind an approval to a head that became the branch tip less than 120 s before the label, or whose push time is unknown, and the gate asks the owner to re-add the label; the residual risk (a page left open longer than the window across a push) is documented.
RF-100 carries a dated correction pointing to the 2026-11-02 waiver and RF-176; its history is not rewritten.
The interim 'remove ready-to-merge before merging' rule is retired and the 'never edit labels on a merged PR' rule is relaxed with a dated note, since label edits no longer run or cancel CI.
The duplicated 'Record owner gate error' step is a `pr-gates.sh gate-error` subcommand, and gate-status fetches the PR JSON once.
nextAction: Owner reviews PR #702 and, if satisfied, adds owner-approved (at least 120 s after its last push); the first approval exercises record-approval live. Then the final review and squash-merge.

evidence.summary: RF-100 merged as 8f26519 under a one-time owner waiver; its squash message lists the five known issues (push race, cancelled CI run, recording-failure description, log-text grep, approval binding to a just-pushed head) that this task fixes.

PR #702 implements all eight items; local gates and a read-only exercise of record-approval, void-approval, gate-status and gate-error against #700's data (writes stubbed) passed. Live label test results are in the PR body.
